title: Signal: Possible an API key in an X-Api-Key header in source
scope: One line, matching an API key in an X-Api-Key header.
limitations: Shape-only, case-insensitive match on a specific header name followed by a token-shaped value. It cannot prove the token is valid, and it does not see headers assembled dynamically.

examples.line: # X-Api-Key is injected by the proxy

fpNotes: Sample requests in documentation, test doubles and recorded HTTP fixtures are the common false positives; the pattern requires a shaped value and vetoes EXAMPLE text.
